audience: online store owners and staff who handle orders and stock in MyCashflow

useCases.title: Find open orders that have not shipped yet
useCases.text: List the orders by status, then read the shipments of each order to see their status and tracking data.

useCases.title: Look up an order by a marketplace order number
useCases.text: Find an order by the external id that your marketplace or shop set on it. Then read its products, customer, payments and status.

useCases.title: Check the stock of a product
useCases.text: Find a product by its product code, then read its stock item and the stock changes with their balance change and reason.

useCases.title: See which customers logged in recently
useCases.text: List customer accounts filtered by last login date. Customer data is personal data, so read only the accounts you need.

useCases.title: Add a private note to an order
useCases.text: Add a private comment to an order. Only store admins see it, and the customer gets no email.

useCases.title: Correct a stock balance after a count
useCases.text: Find the product by its product code and check its stock item. Then add to or subtract from the balance. Each call changes the live stock count.
